entries.text: The bundled SQLGlot runtime moves from 30.25.0.1 to 30.25.0.2 (fork commit `9f51489a1721`). SQLite and DataFusion no longer write a query without its PIVOT or UNPIVOT: `pivot_basic` and `unpivot_basic` returned the unpivoted rows (2,100 and 22,576 rows instead of 2 for the pivot, literal column names for the unpivot). The fork now lowers a PIVOT with one aggregate over literal values to conditional aggregation and an UNPIVOT of plain columns to a UNION ALL, and raises an unsupported error for any other pivot. `ORDER BY ALL` read from a Netezza source is expanded to one ordinal key per selected column with the query's direction, instead of a sort on the constant "ALL" (`orderby_all_desc` on SQLite returned unordered rows under LIMIT). Across 370 shipped benchmark queries (Read Primitives, TPC-H, TPC-DS, ClickBench, TPC-DI, CoffeeShop) translated from their source dialect into all 38 target dialects (14,060 translations), eight outputs differ, all for SQLite and DataFusion: `pivot_basic`, `unpivot_basic`, `orderby_all_simple` and `orderby_all_desc`; every other translation is byte-identical. Published SQLite Read Primitives results for these queries ran the earlier SQL.
